The '''tau serpent''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile|serpent]] that lived<ref name="True" /> by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' take place nearly two [[Standard year|years]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], an event that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Therefore, the novel's events must have occurred by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> when [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] in charge of producing the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], was captured by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] trainer [[Kal Skirata]] and his [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|adopted children]], they [[Clothing/Legends|clothed]] her in a borrowed gown. Upon seeing the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan's]] long neck extend from the outfit, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was reminded of a tau serpent freeing itself from a bag.<ref name="True" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tau sepent was mentioned in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', a [[2007]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] as part of the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series.<ref name="True" />
